-- No requires, no side effects. Returns { list = {...}, byId = {...}, ores = {...}, starterCash = n }.
--
-- This table is the SINGLE source of truth for upgrade prices. Shop cards, world pads, the
-- server purchase check, the tutorial text and the HUD "Next:" hint must all read cost from here.
-- Dropper 2 = 10 and Speed 1 (Fast Belt) = 22, matching the design doc and the tutorial text
-- ("the pad costs $10"). The player starts with 0 cash (Config.STARTING_CASH must match), so the
-- first two collected cubes earn the first purchase.
--
-- BUDGET MATH
--   The first cube (Bronze) is worth 5 cash. The player starts with 0 cash, so the first buy
--   (Dropper 2, 10 cash) is earned by the first two cubes (about 4-8 s after claiming a plot),
--   which fills the HUD goal bar before the pad turns green. After that, income is
--   5 cash/s (2 cubes per 2 s cycle x 5 cash), so every following purchase lands 4-24 s apart.
--   Total cost of all 10 upgrades:
--     10 + 22 + 60 + 150 + 300 + 500 + 800 + 1300 + 2200 + 4000 = 9342 cash
--   Income after each milestone (cubes per 2 s cycle x ore value x cash multiplier, per second),
--   and the approximate wait for the NEXT purchase at that income:
--     base                        1 x 5  x 1.0 / 2 =   2.5 /s   (Dropper 2, 10 -> ~4 s)
--     dropper2                    2 x 5  x 1.0 / 2 =   5   /s   (Speed 1, 22  -> ~4 s)
--     speed1                                           5   /s   (Silver, 60   -> ~8 s)
--     tier_silver                 2 x 12 x 1.0 / 2 =  12   /s   (Dropper 3, 150 -> ~12 s)
--     dropper3                    3 x 12 x 1.0 / 2 =  18   /s   (Cash x1.5, 300 -> ~17 s)
--     mult1 (x1.5)                3 x 12 x 1.5 / 2 =  27   /s   (Gold, 500 -> ~18 s)
--     tier_gold                   3 x 30 x 1.5 / 2 =  67.5 /s   (Speed 2, 800 -> ~12 s)
--     speed2                                          67.5 /s   (Dropper 4, 1300 -> ~19 s)
--     dropper4                    4 x 30 x 1.5 / 2 =  90   /s   (Cash x2, 2200 -> ~24 s)
--     mult2 (x2)                  4 x 30 x 2.0 / 2 = 120   /s   (Diamond, 4000 -> ~33 s)
--     tier_diamond                4 x 75 x 2.0 / 2 = 300   /s
--   (speed upgrades only shorten the trip to the collector.)
--
-- Effect shapes:
--   { kind = "dropper",  slots = n }   total active dropper slots after purchase
--   { kind = "tier",     tier = n }    ore tier every dropper spits out (index into ores)
--   { kind = "speed",    mult = x }    conveyor speed multiplier
--   { kind = "cashMult", mult = x }    collector cash multiplier
--
-- Optional presentation fields (read by the client for the purchase celebration):
--   label  = short headline string
--   popup  = RewardPopup text (shown with Win sting, shockwave ring and FOV punch for ore tiers)
--   color  = Color3 for the shockwave ring / popup (ore tiers)
--
-- Every `requires` points at an existing id, so pads reveal progressively.

local list = {
	{ id = "dropper2", name = "Dropper 2", cost = 10, requires = nil, effect = { kind = "dropper", slots = 2 } },
	{ id = "speed1", name = "Speed 1", cost = 22, requires = "dropper2", effect = { kind = "speed", mult = 1.5 } },
	{
		id = "tier_silver",
		name = "Silver Ore",
		cost = 60,
		requires = "dropper2",
		effect = { kind = "tier", tier = 2 },
		label = "Silver Ore",
		popup = "SILVER ORE! $12 per cube",
		color = Color3.fromRGB(205, 210, 220),
	},
	{ id = "dropper3", name = "Dropper 3", cost = 150, requires = "dropper2", effect = { kind = "dropper", slots = 3 } },
	{ id = "mult1", name = "Cash x1.5", cost = 300, requires = "tier_silver", effect = { kind = "cashMult", mult = 1.5 } },
	{
		id = "tier_gold",
		name = "Gold Ore",
		cost = 500,
		requires = "tier_silver",
		effect = { kind = "tier", tier = 3 },
		label = "Gold Ore",
		popup = "GOLD ORE! $30 per cube",
		color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 40),
	},
	{ id = "speed2", name = "Speed 2", cost = 800, requires = "speed1", effect = { kind = "speed", mult = 2 } },
	{ id = "dropper4", name = "Dropper 4", cost = 1300, requires = "dropper3", effect = { kind = "dropper", slots = 4 } },
	{ id = "mult2", name = "Cash x2", cost = 2200, requires = "mult1", effect = { kind = "cashMult", mult = 2 } },
	{
		id = "tier_diamond",
		name = "Diamond Ore",
		cost = 4000,
		requires = "tier_gold",
		effect = { kind = "tier", tier = 4 },
		label = "Diamond Ore",
		popup = "DIAMOND ORE! $75 per cube",
		color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 235, 255),
	},
}

-- Indexed by tier.
local ores = {
	{ name = "Bronze", value = 5, color = Color3.fromRGB(205, 127, 50), material = Enum.Material.Metal, sparkles = false },
	{ name = "Silver", value = 12, color = Color3.fromRGB(205, 210, 220), material = Enum.Material.Metal, sparkles = false },
	{ name = "Gold", value = 30, color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 40), material = Enum.Material.Foil, sparkles = false },
	{ name = "Diamond", value = 75, color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 235, 255), material = Enum.Material.Glass, sparkles = true },
}

local byId = {}
for _, upgrade in ipairs(list) do
	byId[upgrade.id] = upgrade
end

-- Sanity check: every requirement must reference an existing upgrade id.
for _, upgrade in ipairs(list) do
	if upgrade.requires ~= nil and byId[upgrade.requires] == nil then
		warn("[Upgrades] " .. upgrade.id .. " requires unknown id " .. tostring(upgrade.requires))
	end
end

return {
	list = list,
	byId = byId,
	ores = ores,
	-- Starter grant: 0, so the first two collected $5 cubes earn Dropper 2 (10). Keep Config.STARTING_CASH in sync.
	starterCash = 0,
}

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Upgrades = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Upgrades"))
local Telemetry = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeTelemetry"))
local PlotThemes = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlotThemes"))
local Tycoon = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("Tycoon"))
local CashInService = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("CashInService"))
local JuiceService = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("JuiceService"))
local PadFeedbackService = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("PadFeedbackService"))

local UpgradeService = {}

local NEUTRAL = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 135)
local DEBOUNCE = 0.35
local COLS = 6
local SPACING = 8.5
local MAX_VISIBLE = 3

local list: { any } = Upgrades.list or Upgrades
local byId: { [string]: any } = {}
for _, u in ipairs(list) do
	byId[u.id] = u
end

local states: { [Player]: any } = {}
local plots: { [Player]: any } = {}
local boughtRemote: RemoteEvent? = nil

local function ensureRemote(name: string): RemoteEvent
	local existing = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(name)
	if existing and existing:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		return existing
	end
	local r = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	r.Name = name
	r.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	return r
end
local buyRemote: RemoteEvent = ensureRemote("BuyUpgrade")
local shopSync: RemoteEvent = ensureRemote("ShopSync")
local shopCooldown: { [Player]: number } = {}
local SHOP_COOLDOWN = 0.3
local START_GRANT = 5
local startGranted: { [Player]: boolean } = {}

local function pickColor(t: any, keys: { string }, default: Color3): Color3
	if type(t) ~= "table" then
		return default
	end
	for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
		if typeof(t[k]) == "Color3" then
			return t[k]
		end
	end
	return default
end

local function num(t: any, keys: { string }, default: number): number
	if type(t) ~= "table" then
		return default
	end
	for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
		if type(t[k]) == "number" then
			return t[k]
		end
	end
	return default
end

local function kindOf(u: any): string
	local e = u.effect
	if type(e) == "table" and type(e.kind) == "string" then
		return string.lower(e.kind)
	end
	return ""
end

local function computeMods(owned: { [string]: boolean })
	local slots, ore, speed, cash = 1, 1, 1, 1
	for id in pairs(owned) do
		local u = byId[id]
		if u then
			local k = kindOf(u)
			local e = u.effect
			if k == "slot" or k == "dropper" then
				slots += 1
			elseif k == "tier" then
				ore = math.max(ore, num(e, { "tier", "ore", "value" }, 1))
			elseif k == "speed" or k == "conveyor" then
				speed *= num(e, { "mult", "value", "speed" }, 1)
			elseif k == "cashmult" or k == "cash" or k == "multiplier" then
				cash = math.max(cash, num(e, { "mult", "value", "cashMult" }, 1))
			end
		end
	end
	return { slots = slots, ore = ore, speedMult = speed, cashMult = cash }
end

local function getCash(player: Player): IntValue?
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local c = ls and ls:FindFirstChild("Cash")
	if c and (c:IsA("IntValue") or c:IsA("NumberValue")) then
		return c :: any
	end
	return nil
end

local function padVisible(state: any, u: any): boolean
	if state.owned[u.id] then
		return false
	end
	return u.requires == nil or state.owned[u.requires] == true
end

local function refresh(state: any)
	local cash = getCash(state.player)
	local value = cash and cash.Value or 0
	local shown: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	local shownCount = 0
	for _, lu in ipairs(list) do
		if shownCount < MAX_VISIBLE and padVisible(state, lu) then
			shown[lu.id] = true
			shownCount += 1
		end
	end
	for id, pad in pairs(state.pads) do
		local u = byId[id]
		if pad.part.Parent and u then
			local visible = shown[id] == true
			pad.part.Transparency = visible and 0 or 1
			pad.part.CanTouch = visible
			pad.gui.Enabled = visible
			if visible and not pad.fbReg then
				pad.fbReg = true
				PadFeedbackService.Register(pad.part, state.player, u.cost)
			elseif not visible and pad.fbReg then
				pad.fbReg = false
				PadFeedbackService.Unregister(pad.part)
			end
			if pad.cost then
				pad.cost.TextColor3 = (value >= u.cost) and Color3.fromRGB(88, 214, 92) or Color3.fromRGB(240, 68, 64)
			end
			if visible then
				pad.part.Color = (value >= u.cost) and state.accent or NEUTRAL
				if pad.label then
					pad.label.TextColor3 = (value >= u.cost) and Color3.fromRGB(88, 214, 92) or Color3.fromRGB(240, 68, 64)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function sendOwned(player: Player)
	local state = states[player]
	local ids = {}
